name: M6 Recovery
intro: Full reconciliation, generations and fencing, orphan termination, agent and daemon crashes, a reboot with the service installed, asmai stop draining, terminal disconnects, and crashes during delivery. The milestone table and the accepted documents settle it, so there is no question; review it and accept or annotate. When you accept it I commit it and start M7 Remote hosts.
notes: M1 already keeps dispatches correlated across a restart (C19) and continues work after a clean stop; M6 adds everything an unclean end needs.
Automatic retries of side-effect-free assignments sit here, with recovery, because they are the one case where work after a failure is redone without reconciliation.
The reboot case on the Mac exercises launchd; on Linux, the systemd user unit with linger.
